headlines.text: Flash back to 2025, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Daniel Garcia met in a Number One Contender, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 7.88 ? a good, competitive contest.
Flash back to 2023, when The Butcher & Menard kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.29.
Rewind to 2024, when Mariah May vs. Hikaru Shida met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, serving as the night's main event on Rampage, rated 6.71 ? part of that year's Beach Break '24 - Night 2.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, Allin & Cassidy vs. Swerve in our Glory met for the very first time, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 7.58 ? a well-worked match.
2025 brought us this moment: RPG Vice & Hechicero stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.57.
Turning the clock back to 2025: FTR vs. The Outrunners delivered an excellent showing on Collision, rated 8.27.
